title: Approving a line moves its Quoted inventory part to In stock
custom_preconds:
Setup for claude session

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Owner or Admin) · 1 desktop browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the build named in the test run. You are signed in as an Owner or Admin at one location, [Loc-1].
  • [Part-A]: an inventory part at [Loc-1] with 5 in stock, made for this case only.
  • [WO-1]: a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST SV4802 Approve Line" with one line [Line-1] showing "Needs Approval", and [Part-A] requested on that line from Inventory (quantity 1), showing "Quoted".

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin. Note the location shown in the top bar next to the bell; this is [Loc-1].
  2. Parts > Catalog > New Catalog Part: Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-SV4802-01, Description "ZZAUTOTEST SV4802 approve line part" > Save.
  3. Parts > Inventory > New Inventory Part: Catalog Part = ZZAUTOTEST-SV4802-01, any Category, Cost 10.00, Sell Price 20.00, one bin with Quantity 5 marked Default > Save. This part is [Part-A].
  4. Customers > New Customer: Name "ZZAUTOTEST SV4802 Approve Line" > Save. On the customer page: Contacts tab > New Contact (any name) > Save, then Assets tab > New Asset (pick the contact, any Year, Make and Model) > Save.
  5. Work Orders > Create Work Order: pick that customer and its asset > Save. Write down the work order number shown; this is [WO-1].
  6. In the New Line window, open "What Are You Doing?", pick any ready-made line, leave Line Approved off > Save & Close. This line is [Line-1] and shows "Needs Approval".
  7. On [Line-1] click its three-dot menu > Request part: Part Number = [Part-A] (the Source becomes Inventory), Quantity 1 > Save & Close.
  8. Check the setup worked: [Line-1] shows "Needs Approval" with Approve and Decline buttons, and [Part-A] shows "Quoted". If [Part-A] shows anything else, repeat the last two steps on a new line.
custom_steps:
1. On [WO-1], click Approve on [Line-1]. Do not refresh the page.
  2. Refresh the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: [Line-1] shows Approved.
  • Step 1: without any page refresh, [Part-A] changes from "Quoted" to "In stock", and its "Pick" action is shown.
  • Step 2: after the refresh, [Part-A] still shows "In stock" with the "Pick" action.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Jira SV-4802 "Inventory Part Remains in Quoted Status after Line Status Changes from Need Approval to Approved" (Bug, Done, fix version v0.43 released 11 Nov 2025; epic SV-4796 "V0.43 - Regression Testing Bugs"): Expected Result and Steps to Reproduce; developer comment (Dusan Bulovan, 5 Nov 2025) that a page refresh showed the correct status, so the fix is on screen; fix verified on staging 7 Nov 2025 (Edit Line window and bulk edit) and on production 12 Nov 2025 (Nebojsa Glavinic). Read 8 Oct 2026. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-4802 Expected Result: “The inventory part status should automatically update from `Quoted` to `In stock` with action `Pick`”
  • SV-4802 Steps to Reproduce, step 3: “Change the line status to `Approved`/`Authorized`”
  • SV-4802 comment, Dusan Bulovan, 5 Nov 2025: “Also, page refresh gives the correct part status, which is usually an indicator of FE issue.”
